items.title: Show HN: Whiteboard (YC W26) – An open-source IDE for thoughtful software design
items.title_zh: Show HN：Whiteboard——面向人机协作软件设计的开源 IDE
items.title_en: Show HN: Whiteboard — an open-source IDE for human-AI software design
items.summary: Whiteboard is an open-source desktop IDE where humans and AI agents collaborate on software architecture through an interactive canvas, integrating with tools like Claude Code and Codex.

items.title: Two-tier encryption in the UK
items.title_zh: 苹果在英国下架 iCloud 高级数据保护功能
items.title_en: Apple drops Advanced Data Protection for UK iCloud users
items.summary: The article examines the UK's two-tier encryption landscape and Apple's decision to remove Advanced Data Protection for UK users in response to government legal demands, raising major privacy and surveillance concerns.

items.title_en: Transluce Report Sparks Debate on 'Rogue AI' Agent Hacking Activity

items.title: arXiv receives Multiyear Philanthropic Commitments to Support Its Launch as an Independent Nonprofit [N]
items.title_zh: arXiv获1720万美元捐赠，启动独立非营利组织转型
